summary.plain: A small, extremely quiet chamber of silicon chips deep under a mountain in France, sensitive enough to notice a single electron being knocked loose by a dark matter particle.
summary.technical: 20 g skipper-CCD 'Low Background Chamber' prototype at LSM (Modane); commissioned 2022, with a 1.257 kg-day analysed exposure reported in a November 2025 daily-modulation search for sub-MeV hidden-sector dark matter.

technology.quote: A novel skipper readout implemented in the CCDs provides single electron resolution through multiple non-destructive measurements of the individual pixel charge, pushing the detection threshold to the eV-scale.
technology.value: Skipper-readout silicon CCDs providing single-electron ionization resolution
